description: Registration intelligence for a domain via RDAP (the modern WHOIS). Returns registrar, creation/expiration/last-changed dates, domain age in years, EPP status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC state, and abuse contact. Use to vet a company, assess a lead, or judge how established a domain is.
